articles.headline: Which World Cup records are most likely to be broken in 2026?
articles.description: The latest World Cup presents an opportunity to make history, and North America's expanded tournament this summer could be one to rewrite the record books.

articles.headline: Not even Messi's magic could will Argentina to back-to-back World Cups
articles.description: Argentina were well beaten by Spain in the 2026 World Cup final, but the defending champions were also battling against history in New Jersey.

articles.headline: Spain open as betting favorite to repeat at 2030 World Cup
articles.description: With the 2026 World Cup complete, bookmakers are already looking ahead four years to the 2030 tournament, where they have already installed co-host Spain as the favorite to repeat as world champion.

articles.headline: Source: Italy sound out Pep Guardiola for manager role
articles.description: Italy have sounded out the possibility of appointing Pep Guardiola as their next coach after missing out on this summer's World Cup, a source told ESPN.
